page.overview:
Who is Auric Goldfinger?

Auric Goldfinger was a bullion dealer, jeweller, metallurgist and international gold smuggler. He appeared in the 2004 video game 007 Legends where he was voiced by Timothy Watson with the likeness of Gert Fröbe.
